title: Spicy Vegan Quinoa Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and a spicy kick.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook according to package instructions.
Cut the sweet potato and red bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Toss the vegetables with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 25-30 minutes or until tender.
Heat the spicy sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cooked black beans and cooked quinoa to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the roasted vegetables to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the quinoa mixture in a bowl topped with sliced avocado (if using).
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro (if desired).
